name: Genealogy and family history
description: A family tree in a CSV or GEDCOM file: dates checked, duplicates found, trees and anniversaries listed.
note: This is a genealogy project: a family tree kept as a people CSV or a simple GEDCOM text file. Never invent a relative, a date, a place or a source, and never merge two people or add a link without the evidence; where a fact is missing say it is missing. Every fact should cite its source (a register, certificate, census, interview) and the agent says which fact has none. Keep dates as found: a partial or approximate date (1850, ABT 1850, BEF 1900) stays partial. Names are spelled as the sources spell them, with variants noted, not corrected. Living people's details are private: do not publish or share them. Keep the original file untouched and write corrected copies under new names. Run the Family history Check after every change and fix what it lists; a flagged date is a reason to look at the source again, not proof of an error. This is a checking aid for the user's own research, not proof of descent or legal advice (inheritance, citizenship).
details: Researching a family from a plain file. The Family history tool reads a people CSV (id, name, sex, born, died, father, mother, spouse, married, source, found by name in English, French, German, Italian, Portuguese and Spanish) or a simple GEDCOM file. It checks the tree (death before birth, a child born before a parent or after a mother's death, a parent too young or too old, a marriage before a birth or after a death, unknown parent ids, loops, facts with no source) with the line of each problem; finds people who may be the same person; prints the descendants or ancestors of anyone as an indented tree; and lists ages at death and birthdays, death days and wedding days in calendar order. Partial and approximate dates are never made precise. Nobody is invented: a missing parent stays missing.
examples: Check my family tree for impossible dates
Print all the descendants of my great-grandmother
Which birthdays and wedding days fall this month?
